p2 = json.loads(prod2_raw.split('\n[stderr]\n', 1)[0].strip())["result"]
p3 = json.loads(prod3_raw.split('\n[stderr]\n', 1)[0].strip())["result"]

def format_product(p):
    lines = []
    lines.append(f"**Product ID:** {p.get('product_id', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"**Name:** {p.get('name', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"**Category:** {p.get('category', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"**Price:** ${p.get('price', 'N/A')}")
    if p.get('price_drop'):
        lines.append(f"**Price Drop:** Was ${p['price_drop'].get('old_price', 'N/A')} → Now ${p['price_drop'].get('new_price', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"**Rating:** {p.get('rating', 'N/A')} / 5")
    lines.append(f"**In Stock:** {'Yes' if p.get('in_stock') else 'No'} (Stock: {p.get('stock', 'N/A')})")
    lines.append(f"**Description:** {p.get('description', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"**Shipping Days:** {p.get('shipping_days', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"**Gift Wrap Available:** {'Yes' if p.get('gift_wrap_available') else 'No'}")
    if p.get('specs'):
        lines.append("**Specs:**")
        for k, v in p['specs'].items():
            lines.append(f"  - {k}: {v}")
    if p.get('compatible_with'):
        lines.append(f"**Compatible With:** {', '.join(p['compatible_with'])}")
    if p.get('variants'):
        lines.append(f"**Variants:** {json.dumps(p['variants'])}")
    return '\n'.join(lines)

file_content = "# Wireless Mouse Options — Saved for Review\n"
file_content += "_This list is separate from your shopping cart._\n\n"
file_content += f"---\n\n## 1. {p1.get('name', 'PROD-FA0948')}\n\n{format_product(p1)}\n\n"
